idea.title: Every missed message is a missed commission
idea.angle: A fill-in-your-own-numbers calculation of what slow replies cost (no invented stats)
idea.hook: Work out what slow replies really cost you, in 4 quick steps

slides.heading: What Slow Replies **Cost** You
slides.body: 4 quick steps. Use your own numbers.

slides.heading: Count **Enquiries**
slides.body: WhatsApp, DMs, calls. Say you get 40 a month. Write yours down.

slides.heading: Count The **Missed** Ones
slides.body: Slow replies and no follow-up. Be honest. Say 10.

slides.heading: Know Your **Close Rate**
slides.body: Out of 10 good leads, how many usually rent or buy? Say 1.

slides.heading: Add Your **Commission**
slides.body: Your average commission per deal, in cedis or naira.

slides.heading: Your **Monthly** Leak
bullets: Missed leads x close rate x commission
Say 10 missed, 1 in 10 close: one deal gone

slides.heading: Ready To **Plug The Leak**?
slides.body: Follow @kortexa and DM 'SYSTEM' for a free trial

caption:
Every missed message is a missed commission. Here's how to put a number on it.

Count your monthly enquiries.
Count the ones that got a slow reply or no follow-up.
Multiply by your close rate.
Multiply by your average commission in cedis or naira.
That's what your leak costs you every month.

Did you do the maths? Was it more or less than you expected?
